name: smol-toml
purpose: Validate TOML source and targets before deterministic owned-table insertion without reserializing project-authored configuration.
alternativesConsidered: Reserialize complete project TOML and discard comments
maintenanceStatus: Pinned to the upstream v1.7.1 release tag and used only at the installer trust boundary.
securityEvidence: Registry metadata, exact release source, BSD-3-Clause license, package integrity, and Node.js engine requirement were reviewed.
modifications: None; table ownership, marker syntax, and project formatting preservation remain project-owned.
requiredNotices: Preserve the BSD-3-Clause license notice when redistribution requires it.
